newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends up, July firms on slip in ratings.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends up, July firms on slip in ratings.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended firmer, with new crop July up on a decline in wheat condition ratings and nearby March rallying as buy stops were hit on the close, traders said.
The agricultural statistics services in Kansas and Oklahoma reported Monday that winter wheat ratings had declined slightly during January due to a dry surface soil conditions.
"Cargill and (Benson-Quinn) bought around 300,000 March at the close," a trader said. "And our July gained after the reports came out last night."
Traders said the CBOT/KCBT March spread widened by five cents as KCBT March ended up relative to its CBOT counterpart.
KCBT wheat settled 1-1/4 to 3-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with March up 1-1/4 cents at $4.06-1/4.
Traders complained at the close that volumes had been very light throughout the session.
